<subject>Re: Pinnacle Equity Partners</subject>
<body>

Sent: 2/27/2024 3:26 PM
Subject: Pinnacle Equity Partners

Pinnacle Capital has gotten back to me and is vacillating on what they want to do with the Horizon Portfolio assets.  In particular, they haven't thought through what they want to do with the digital investments, don't like the current electronic documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the asset agreements once they decide how to resolve this.  So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Apex financial portfolios and master agreements sit.
</quoted>
